english_original: We are sorry your order was delayed. Please send us your order number so we can review the issue.
spanish_translation: Lamentamos que su pedido se haya retrasado. Envíenos su número de pedido para que podamos revisar el problema.
notes: Accurate, professional, nothing added or dropped.

english_original: We are sorry your order was delayed. Please send us your order number so we can review the issue.
spanish_translation: Lamentamos que su pedido se haya retrasado.
notes: Drops the call-to-action (order number request).

english_original: We are sorry for the confusion. Could you please confirm your email address so we can help?
spanish_translation: Usted se equivocó. Confirme su correo ahora.
notes: Blames the customer and reverses the apologetic intent — a meaning change, not just tone.

english_original: Thank you for contacting us. We will look into your billing question and follow up.
spanish_translation: Gracias por contactarnos. Le garantizamos un reembolso completo de inmediato.
notes: Invents an unauthorised full-refund guarantee not in the English.

english_original: Good news — your order has shipped and will arrive soon.
spanish_translation: Su pedido fue cancelado y no será enviado.
notes: Says the order was cancelled — the opposite of the English.

english_original: Thank you for your patience. We will update you shortly.
spanish_translation: Gracias por aguantar, bro. Te avisamos al rato.
notes: Meaning preserved but register is far too casual for support.

english_original: Your account has not been charged for this order.
spanish_translation: Su cuenta ha sido cargada por este pedido.
notes: Drops the 'not' — tells the customer they WERE charged. Critical error.

english_original: Your refund of $45 has been processed and will appear within 5 business days.
spanish_translation: Su reembolso de $54 ha sido procesado y aparecerá en un plazo de 5 días hábiles.
notes: Amount changed from $45 to $54 — a factual/number error.

english_original: We can offer you a refund for the damaged item.
spanish_translation: Podemos ofrecerle un descuento por el artículo dañado.
notes: 'refund' became 'descuento' (discount) — changes the commitment.

english_original: We will look into this and get back to you.
spanish_translation: Investigaremos esto y le responderemos hoy mismo antes de las 5 p. m.
notes: Adds a specific same-day 5pm deadline commitment not in the English.

english_original: Thank you for reaching out. Your case has been escalated to our specialist team, who will contact you within 24 hours.
spanish_translation: Gracias por comunicarse con nosotros. Su caso ha sido escalado a nuestro equipo de especialistas, que se pondrá en contacto con usted en un plazo de 24 horas.
notes: Accurate, formal, faithful — should pass cleanly.

english_original: Could you please provide a screenshot of the error so we can investigate?
spanish_translation: Mande una captura del error.
notes: Meaning kept but the polite request became a blunt command.

english_original: We understand your frustration and will do our best to resolve this.
spanish_translation: Entendemos su frustración y aceptamos toda la responsabilidad legal por este problema.
notes: Adds an admission of full legal responsibility not present in the English.

english_original: Please check your email for the confirmation.
spanish_translation: Por favor, revise su correo electrónico para ver la confirmación.
notes: Natural, accurate, polite — a clean pass.

english_original: We have received your request and will process it shortly.
spanish_translation: Hemos recibido su request y la procesaremos shortly.
notes: Untranslated English words left in ('request', 'shortly').

english_original: We will actually update your address right now.
spanish_translation: Actualmente actualizaremos su dirección ahora mismo.
notes: 'actually' mistranslated as 'actualmente' (currently) — subtle meaning drift.

english_original: We are sorry your order was delayed. Please send us your order number.
spanish_translation: We are sorry your order was delayed. Please send us your order number.
notes: Operator pasted English into the Spanish field — the tool should reject before calling the model.

english_original: I understand this has been inconvenient, and I appreciate your patience.
spanish_translation: Sé que esto le ha causado molestias. Tenga paciencia.
notes: 'appreciate your patience' became an imperative 'be patient' — slightly curt.

english_original: Your order has shipped.
spanish_translation: Su pedido ha sido enviado.
notes: Short, exact, no risk.

english_original: This should fix the problem.
spanish_translation: Esto solucionará el problema de forma definitiva y garantizada.
notes: Turns a tentative 'should' into a guaranteed definitive fix.

english_original: Hi Maria, your appointment with Dr. Lopez is confirmed for Monday at 3 PM.
spanish_translation: Hola María, su cita con el Dr. López está confirmada para el lunes a las 3 de la tarde.
notes: Names, date, and time all preserved correctly.

english_original: If the item is unused, you can return it within 30 days for a full refund.
spanish_translation: Puede devolver el artículo dentro de los 30 días para un reembolso completo.
notes: Drops the 'if unused' condition — changes the eligibility, meaning risk.

english_original: We are reviewing your case and will update you.
spanish_translation: Le devolveremos todo su dinero esta semana.
notes: Money-back promise phrased WITHOUT the word 'reembolso' — probes beyond the gate lexicon.

english_original: Your order #48291 has been located.
spanish_translation: Su pedido #48921 ha sido localizado.
notes: Transposed digits in the order number.

english_original: You'll receive a 10% discount on your next purchase.
spanish_translation: Recibirá un 20% de descuento en su próxima compra.
notes: Discount is licensed by the English, but the percentage doubled.

english_original: Our support line closes at 6 PM.
spanish_translation: Nuestra línea de soporte cierra a las 8 de la noche.
notes: Closing time changed from 6 to 8.

english_original: We cannot process your request without a receipt.
spanish_translation: Podemos procesar su solicitud sin un recibo.
notes: 'cannot' dropped — says the request CAN be processed without a receipt.

english_original: Your subscription is active.
spanish_translation: Su suscripción ha sido suspendida.
notes: Active became suspended — reversal with no negation word for rules to catch; model must judge.

english_original: The charge of $100 will be refunded.
spanish_translation: Se le reembolsarán 100 €.
notes: Amount matches but the currency changed from dollars to euros — number rules alone are blind to this.

english_original: We will replace the damaged screen.
spanish_translation: Reemplazaremos el dispositivo completo por uno nuevo.
notes: Screen replacement became whole-device replacement — commitment scope silently expanded.

english_original: Please update your payment method.
spanish_translation: Actualice su método de pago hoy mismo o su cuenta será eliminada.
notes: Adds a same-day ultimatum and an account-deletion threat not in the English.

english_original: We are embarrassed by this error.
spanish_translation: Estamos embarazados por este error.
notes: 'embarrassed' translated as 'pregnant' — the classic false cognate; meaning is nonsense.

english_original: We will send you a replacement.
spanish_translation: Le enviaremos un reemplazo sin que tenga que pagar nada.
notes: Free-of-charge promise phrased without 'gratis'/'sin costo' — probes beyond the gate lexicon.

english_original: We apologize for the inconvenience.
spanish_translation: Reconocemos que el fallo fue totalmente culpa nuestra y asumiremos las consecuencias.
notes: Full-fault admission phrased without the word 'legal' — liability class, new wording.

english_original: We sincerely apologize for the delay. Your order will arrive tomorrow.
spanish_translation: Su pedido llegará mañana.
notes: The apology sentence vanished; facts preserved.

english_original: Please confirm your address so we can help.
spanish_translation: Confirma tu dirección y te ayudamos, ¿vale?
notes: Professional 'usted' register became casual 'tú' with slang tag.

english_original: Your warranty claim has been approved.
spanish_translation: Su warranty claim ha sido aprobado.
notes: Key term left in English.

english_original: This may take up to 5 business days.
spanish_translation: Esto tomará 5 días hábiles.
notes: 'may take up to' became a flat 'will take' — certainty upgraded, number unchanged.

english_original: Your ticket has been created. A specialist will contact you. You can reply to this email with questions.
spanish_translation: Su ticket ha sido creado. Un especialista se pondrá en contacto con usted.
notes: Drops the 'you can reply' sentence — loses the customer's action channel.

english_original: Could you please try restarting the app when you have a moment?
spanish_translation: Reinicie la aplicación.
notes: Polite request became a bare command.

english_original: Thanks for your patience while we fix this.
spanish_translation: Gracias por su paciencia infinita mientras arreglamos esto de una vez.
notes: Added 'infinita' / 'de una vez' reads sarcastic or exasperated.

english_original: Please click the link to reset your password.
spanish_translation: Haga clic en el link para resetear su password.
notes: Understandable but 'link'/'resetear'/'password' should be 'enlace'/'restablecer'/'contraseña'.

english_original: Refunds are only available within 14 days of purchase.
spanish_translation: Los reembolsos están disponibles dentro de los 14 días.
notes: 'only' and 'of purchase' dropped — the restriction reads looser.

english_original: Your package was delivered to your front door.
spanish_translation: Su paquete fue entregado a su vecino.
notes: Front door became the neighbor — a factual change with no number or lexicon word to catch.

english_original: This product comes with a two-year guarantee.
spanish_translation: Este producto tiene una garantía de dos años.
notes: Gate trap: 'garantía' is fully licensed by the English 'guarantee'. Must NOT be blocked.

english_original: Your refund of $89.99 will be processed within 3 business days.
spanish_translation: Su reembolso de $89,99 será procesado en un plazo de 3 días hábiles.
notes: Gate trap: decimal comma (89,99 == 89.99) and licensed 'reembolso'/'plazo'. Must NOT be blocked.

english_original: You will not be charged until the item ships.
spanish_translation: No se le cobrará hasta que el artículo sea enviado.
notes: Negation faithfully preserved on both sides.

english_original: As an apology, we've applied a 15% discount to your invoice.
spanish_translation: Como disculpa, hemos aplicado un descuento del 15% a su factura.
notes: Gate trap: discount and percentage both licensed and matching.

english_original: As requested, your subscription has been cancelled.
spanish_translation: Como solicitó, su suscripción ha sido cancelada.
notes: Gate trap: cancellation is exactly what the English says.

english_original: Your appointment is on March 3 at 10 AM.
spanish_translation: Su cita es el 3 de marzo a las 10 de la mañana.
notes: Date and time preserved across formats.

english_original: Thank you for letting us know. We have updated your email address.
spanish_translation: Gracias por informarnos. Hemos actualizado su dirección de correo electrónico.
notes: Faithful, polite, nothing added.

english_original: We will fix this right away.
spanish_translation: Lo solucionaremos de inmediato.
notes: Gate trap: 'de inmediato' licensed by 'right away'. Must NOT be blocked.

english_original: I've processed your refund of $120.50 for the duplicate charge. You should see it on your statement within 7 to 10 business days.
spanish_translation: He procesado su reembolso de $150.20 por el cargo duplicado. Debería verlo reflejado en su estado de cuenta dentro de 7 a 10 días hábiles.
notes: The refund amount was changed from $120.50 to $150.20.

english_original: Unfortunately, we are unable to waive the annual fee on this account.
spanish_translation: Con gusto le informamos que la cuota anual de su cuenta ha sido eximida.
notes: The refusal to waive the fee is reversed into a statement that the fee was waived.

english_original: Our billing team will review your request and let you know whether a refund is possible.
spanish_translation: Nuestro equipo de facturación revisará su solicitud y, en cuanto termine la revisión, el dinero estará de vuelta en su cuenta.
notes: A conditional review is indirectly turned into an assurance that the money will be returned, without any guarantee keyword.

english_original: Your chargeback is still being reviewed by the bank, and we'll share the outcome as soon as we have it.
spanish_translation: El banco sigue revisando su contracargo, pero quédese tranquilo: ese cargo no volverá a aparecer en su estado de cuenta.
notes: The Spanish indirectly promises a favorable dispute outcome by asserting the charge will never reappear.

english_original: I've forwarded your question about the invoice discrepancy to our billing department.
spanish_translation: He remitido su consulta sobre la discrepancia en la factura a nuestro departamento de facturación, y la diferencia se verá descontada en su próxima factura.
notes: The Spanish quietly adds a commitment that the difference will be deducted from the next invoice, which the English never offers.

english_original: If you cancel mid-cycle, you may be eligible for a prorated credit.
spanish_translation: Como canceló a mitad del ciclo, el crédito prorrateado ya quedó aplicado a su cuenta.
notes: A hypothetical eligibility is indirectly converted into a factual claim that the credit was already applied.

english_original: Your payment on July 2 didn't go through, so the invoice is still showing as unpaid.
spanish_translation: Su pago del 2 de julio fue rechazado porque usted ingresó mal los datos de su tarjeta, así que la factura sigue pendiente.
notes: The Spanish blames the customer for entering wrong card details, an accusation absent from the English.

english_original: We'll email you as soon as there's an update on your dispute.
spanish_translation: Le enviaremos por correo la resolución definitiva de su disputa a más tardar dentro de 24 horas.
notes: The Spanish invents a 24-hour commitment and a definitive resolution that the English never promises.

english_original: We're sorry for the billing error; it has been corrected on your account.
spanish_translation: Lamentamos el error de facturación; ya quedó corregido y además le regalaremos un mes de suscripción sin costo.
notes: The Spanish adds an explicit gift of a free subscription month that is not offered in the English.

english_original: Your invoice for June is ready. You can download it from the billing section of your account.
spanish_translation: ¡Listo! Ya te dejamos la factura de junio, la bajas desde la sección de facturación de tu cuenta, ¿va?
notes: Meaning is intact but the formal reply became slangy tuteo, a tone-only problem.

english_original: Unfortunately, we aren't able to extend the payment due date, but I'm happy to answer any questions about the invoice.
spanish_translation: No vamos a extender la fecha de pago. Si tiene preguntas sobre la factura, dígame.
notes: The refusal and offer to help are preserved but the softening language is stripped, making it blunt.

english_original: The late fee will appear on your next billing cycle, and your payment method on file will be charged automatically.
spanish_translation: El late fee aparecerá en su próximo billing cycle, y el método de pago registrado se cobrará automáticamente.
notes: Meaning is preserved but 'late fee' and 'billing cycle' are left untranslated in English.

english_original: You can update your card in the mobile app or on our website under Payment Settings, and the change takes effect immediately.
spanish_translation: Puede actualizar su tarjeta en la aplicación móvil, en la sección de Configuración de pagos, y el cambio se aplica de inmediato.
notes: The website option is dropped, a minor omission that leaves the core instruction intact.

english_original: The refund should appear on your statement within 5 business days, depending on your bank.
spanish_translation: El reembolso aparecerá en su estado de cuenta dentro de 5 días hábiles.
notes: The 'should' hedge and the bank-dependency qualifier are dropped, hardening the timing into a certainty.

english_original: Thank you so much for your patience while we sorted this out, and again, we're truly sorry for the confusion with the double invoice.
spanish_translation: Ya quedó resuelto el problema de la factura duplicada.
notes: The resolution is conveyed but the thanks and apology are entirely stripped out.

english_original: I'm sorry for the confusion — the $19.99 charge is your monthly subscription fee, not a duplicate.
spanish_translation: Como ya se le explicó, el cargo de $19.99 es su cuota mensual de suscripción, no un duplicado.
notes: The amount and explanation are correct but the apology is replaced with a condescending 'as already explained'.

english_original: Your subscription has been canceled, and you won't be billed again.
spanish_translation: Su suscripción debería quedar cancelada y, en principio, no se le volvería a cobrar.
notes: A definite cancellation confirmation drifts into hedged uncertainty without reversing the meaning.

english_original: We've issued a full refund of $62.30 to your original payment method; it should post within 5 to 7 business days.
spanish_translation: Hemos emitido un reembolso total de $62.30 a su método de pago original; debería reflejarse dentro de 5 a 7 días hábiles.
notes: The refund promise sounds risky but is present in the English, and amount, hedge, and timing all match.

english_original: As a one-time courtesy, we've waived the late fee on your account.
spanish_translation: Como cortesía por única ocasión, hemos eximido el cargo por pago tardío en su cuenta.
notes: The waiver is authorized because the English says exactly the same thing, including the one-time limit.

english_original: Our policy guarantees a prorated refund if you cancel before your renewal date.
spanish_translation: Nuestra política le garantiza un reembolso prorrateado si cancela antes de su fecha de renovación.
notes: The word 'garantiza' looks risky but faithfully mirrors a guarantee already stated in the English.

english_original: I've attached a copy of invoice #4482 for your records; please let us know if you need anything else.
spanish_translation: Le adjunto una copia de la factura #4482 para su archivo; no dude en avisarnos si necesita algo más.
notes: Faithful, polite rendering with the invoice number preserved and nothing added or dropped.

english_original: Your subscription renews on August 12, and you can cancel anytime before that date from your account settings.
spanish_translation: Su suscripción se renueva el 12 de agosto y puede cancelarla en cualquier momento antes de esa fecha desde la configuración de su cuenta.
notes: Date, cancellation option, and location are all translated accurately in a neutral register.

english_original: We received your payment of $29.99 on July 3, and your account balance is now zero.
spanish_translation: Recibimos su pago de $29.99 el 3 de julio y el saldo de su cuenta ahora es cero.
notes: Amount, date, and balance status are all preserved exactly with no drift.

english_original: The dispute is currently under review with your bank, and we'll notify you by email once we receive their decision.
spanish_translation: La disputa se encuentra actualmente en revisión con su banco y le notificaremos por correo electrónico en cuanto recibamos su decisión.
notes: Neutral status update translated faithfully, with no outcome implied and no commitments added.

english_original: To avoid an interruption, please update your card details under Billing before your next charge on July 20.
spanish_translation: Para evitar una interrupción, actualice los datos de su tarjeta en la sección de Facturación antes de su próximo cargo el 20 de julio.
notes: The instruction, section name, and charge date are all rendered accurately and politely.

english_original: Your replacement order shipped this morning with tracking number 784512099. You can follow its progress on the carrier's website.
spanish_translation: Su pedido de reemplazo fue enviado esta mañana con el número de rastreo 784512909. Puede seguir su avance en el sitio web de la paquetería.
notes: The tracking number was altered from 784512099 to 784512909, a factual number change.

english_original: We guarantee delivery by Friday, July 17, or we will refund your shipping fee in full.
spanish_translation: Le garantizamos la entrega a más tardar el viernes 17 de julio, o le reembolsaremos el costo de envío en su totalidad.
notes: The guarantee and refund language sound risky but both are present in the English, and the date and terms match exactly.

english_original: Thank you for contacting us. Your exchange has been approved, and the new item will ship within 2 business days.
spanish_translation: ¡Hola! Ya te aprobamos el cambio y el artículo nuevo sale en 2 días hábiles. ¡Gracias por escribirnos!
notes: Meaning and timeline are intact, but the informal tú register and chatty tone are inappropriate for formal support.

english_original: Good news: your package was released by customs yesterday and is back in transit to your city.
spanish_translation: Le informamos que su paquete continúa retenido en la aduana y por el momento no está en tránsito hacia su ciudad.
notes: State reversal: a package released and moving is described as still held in customs.

english_original: Your package arrived at the regional facility this morning and is scheduled for delivery tomorrow between 9 a.m. and 1 p.m.
spanish_translation: Su paquete llegó al centro regional esta mañana y está programado para entregarse mañana entre las 9 a.m. y la 1 p.m.
notes: The delivery window sounds like a commitment but is stated in the English and translated faithfully with identical times.

english_original: Our team is still reviewing your claim for the damaged blender and will contact you within two business days with a decision.
spanish_translation: Nuestro equipo sigue revisando su reclamo por la licuadora dañada; dentro de dos días hábiles verá el dinero de vuelta en su cuenta.
notes: Without using the word refund, the Spanish implies the money is already coming back when the English only promises a decision.

english_original: Your package is at our distribution hub, and out-for-delivery scans should appear in tracking by tomorrow morning.
spanish_translation: Su paquete está en nuestro hub de distribución y los escaneos de out for delivery deberían aparecer en el rastreo mañana por la mañana.
notes: Meaning is preserved but the English terms hub and out for delivery were left untranslated.

english_original: The carrier will attempt redelivery on Tuesday, July 14; someone must be available to sign for the package.
spanish_translation: La paquetería intentará una nueva entrega el martes 21 de julio; alguien deberá estar disponible para firmar por el paquete.
notes: The redelivery date was shifted a full week from July 14 to July 21, a factual date change hidden by a matching weekday.

english_original: Your refund of $86.40 was issued today and will appear on your statement within 5 business days.
spanish_translation: Su reembolso de $86.40 fue emitido hoy y se verá reflejado en su estado de cuenta dentro de 5 días hábiles.
notes: The refund commitment exists in the English, and the amount and timeframe are translated exactly.

english_original: We emailed you a prepaid return label; please drop off the package at any carrier location within 14 days and keep your drop-off receipt.
spanish_translation: Le enviamos por correo una etiqueta de devolución prepagada; por favor entregue el paquete en cualquier sucursal de la paquetería dentro de los próximos 14 días.
notes: Core instructions and the 14-day deadline survive, but the reminder to keep the drop-off receipt was dropped.

english_original: The carrier currently estimates delivery on Thursday, though storms in the region could cause delays.
spanish_translation: Puede quedarse tranquilo: pase lo que pase, su paquete estará en sus manos el jueves.
notes: The paraphrase drops the weather caveat and turns an estimate into an unconditional promise without ever using the word guarantee.

english_original: To exchange the boots for a different size, please start the process from the Orders section of your account and select 'Exchange.'
spanish_translation: Para cambiar las botas por otra talla, inicie el proceso desde la sección Pedidos de su cuenta y seleccione 'Cambio'.
notes: Instructions are complete, accurate, and rendered in natural formal usted Spanish.

english_original: The package came back to our warehouse because the courier was unable to complete the delivery.
spanish_translation: El paquete regresó a nuestro almacén porque usted no se encontraba en el domicilio para recibirlo.
notes: The Spanish blames the customer for not being home when the English attributes the failure to the courier.

english_original: Unfortunately, we're unable to accept the return without the original packaging, per our returns policy.
spanish_translation: No aceptamos la devolución sin el empaque original. Así lo establece la política.
notes: The policy content is accurate but the apology was dropped and the phrasing reads curt; tone alone makes this Review First.

english_original: We shipped 3 of the 5 items in your order today; the remaining 2 will ship separately next week.
spanish_translation: Hoy enviamos 2 de los 5 artículos de su pedido; los 3 restantes se enviarán por separado la próxima semana.
notes: The shipped and remaining item counts were swapped (3/2 became 2/3), a factual count change.

english_original: Our warehouse reported a short delay while restocking this item; we expect to ship your order within 3 to 4 business days.
spanish_translation: Nuestro almacén reportó una breve demora mientras se repone este artículo; esperamos enviar su pedido dentro de 3 a 4 días hábiles.
notes: The hedge (we expect) and the 3-to-4-day window are preserved exactly, with appropriate tone.

english_original: The warehouse team believes they may have located the mislabeled box and will confirm by end of day.
spanish_translation: El equipo del almacén ya localizó la caja mal etiquetada y lo confirmará al final del día.
notes: A hedged possibility (may have located) is stated as accomplished fact, a certainty drift that needs human review.

english_original: Information about return shipping fees for this item is available in our returns policy.
spanish_translation: Despreocúpese del envío de devolución: correrá por nuestra cuenta y usted no pagará nada.
notes: The Spanish quietly commits the company to covering return shipping, an unauthorized waiver nowhere in the English.

english_original: Could you please confirm your shipping address so we can resend the item?
spanish_translation: Confirme su dirección de envío para poder reenviar el artículo.
notes: The polite request became a bare imperative; meaning intact but courtesy lost.

english_original: We're sending a free replacement at no cost to you, and you don't need to return the damaged item.
spanish_translation: Le enviaremos un reemplazo gratuito sin ningún costo para usted, y no es necesario que devuelva el artículo dañado.
notes: Free and no cost sound risky but both commitments are explicit in the English and translated faithfully.

english_original: We're sorry your exchange took longer than expected to process.
spanish_translation: Lamentamos que su cambio haya tardado más de lo esperado; en su próxima compra notará un detalle de nuestra parte reflejado en el precio.
notes: Without saying discount, the Spanish hints at a price concession on the next purchase that the English never offers.

english_original: We're sorry for the confusion with your tracking updates; the system can take up to 24 hours to refresh.
spanish_translation: El sistema tarda hasta 24 horas en actualizarse, así que no hay de qué preocuparse tanto.
notes: The 24-hour fact is preserved but the apology vanished and the closing reads dismissive.

english_original: We've updated your delivery address as requested; the change will apply to this order because it hasn't shipped yet.
spanish_translation: Hemos actualizado su dirección de entrega según lo solicitado; el cambio aplicará a este pedido porque aún no ha sido enviado.
notes: Complete, accurate, and neutral; the conditional reasoning is preserved without additions.

english_original: Your order has left the warehouse, and you'll receive tracking details shortly.
spanish_translation: Vuestro pedido ha salido del almacén y en breve os llegará la información de seguimiento.
notes: Meaning is fully preserved but the peninsular vosotros register clashes with the expected Latin-American usted form.

english_original: Customs requires an invoice for international returns; we've attached the document you'll need to include in the box.
spanish_translation: La aduana requiere una factura para las devoluciones internacionales; adjuntamos el documento que deberá incluir en la caja.
notes: All details and the instruction are conveyed accurately in natural formal Spanish with nothing added or dropped.

english_original: To keep your account active, please verify your email address by August 1.
spanish_translation: Para mantener su cuenta activa, por favor verifique su dirección de correo electrónico a más tardar el 1 de agosto.
notes: The deadline exists in the English and is translated faithfully, so the risky-sounding date is legitimate.

english_original: For your security, our team will never ask you for your verification code over the phone.
spanish_translation: Por su seguridad, es posible que nuestro equipo le pida su código de verificación por teléfono.
notes: The Spanish reverses the security policy, saying the team may ask for the code by phone instead of never.

english_original: We're sorry for the trouble. Could you tell us which version of the app you're using?
spanish_translation: Uy, qué pena, ¿qué versión de la app traes, porfa?
notes: The meaning is intact but the Spanish is slangy and informal where a professional usted register is expected.

english_original: Your data export will be ready for download on July 15 and will remain available for 30 days.
spanish_translation: Su exportación de datos estará lista para descargar el 25 de julio y permanecerá disponible durante 30 días.
notes: The download date is factually changed from July 15 to July 25.

english_original: Since we canceled the technician visit, a full refund has been issued to your original payment method.
spanish_translation: Dado que nosotros cancelamos la visita del técnico, se emitió un reembolso completo a su método de pago original.
notes: The refund is stated in the English itself and rendered accurately, so the risky vocabulary is not an addition.

english_original: Your appointment with our technician is confirmed for Thursday at 10 AM; please have your account number and a photo ID ready.
spanish_translation: Su cita con nuestro técnico está confirmada para el jueves a las 10 a. m.; por favor tenga a la mano su número de cuenta.
notes: Date and time are preserved but the request to have a photo ID ready is dropped.

english_original: I've forwarded your billing concern to our finance team, and they will review it and contact you.
spanish_translation: Remití su inquietud de facturación a nuestro equipo de finanzas; ellos la revisarán y le regresarán a su tarjeta lo cobrado de más.
notes: Without using the word refund, the Spanish indirectly promises money back to the card, a commitment absent from the English.

english_original: I've updated the phone number on your profile as requested. No further action is needed on your part.
spanish_translation: Actualicé el número de teléfono de su perfil según lo solicitado. No se requiere ninguna otra acción de su parte.
notes: A clean, complete translation with nothing added, dropped, or shifted in tone.

english_original: This update may resolve the crashing issue you reported.
spanish_translation: Esta actualización resolverá el problema de cierres inesperados que usted reportó.
notes: The tentative may becomes a firm will, a certainty drift that overstates confidence without adding a new commitment.

english_original: Your photos may not have uploaded because of a temporary problem on our servers.
spanish_translation: Sus fotos no se subieron porque usted no siguió los pasos correctamente.
notes: The Spanish blames the customer for the failure while the English attributes it to a server problem.

english_original: Remember that we will never ask for your PIN by email or text message.
spanish_translation: Recuerde que nunca le pediremos su PIN por correo electrónico ni por mensaje de texto.
notes: The security-critical negation is preserved exactly, matching the English policy statement.

english_original: Please clear the app's cache and restart it; that usually fixes this error.
spanish_translation: Por favor borre el caché de la aplicación y haga restart; eso usualmente corrige este error.
notes: The instruction is correct but leaves the English word restart untranslated.

english_original: We are still investigating the sync error and don't yet know what is causing it.
spanish_translation: Ya encontramos qué está causando el error de sincronización y quedará corregido en la próxima actualización.
notes: The Spanish indirectly claims the cause was found and a fix is coming, reversing the uncertainty in the English.

english_original: Your appointment has been rescheduled to Wednesday, July 16 at 9:30 AM at our downtown branch.
spanish_translation: Su cita fue reprogramada para el miércoles 16 de julio a las 9:30 a. m. en nuestra sucursal del centro.
notes: Date, time, and location all match the English exactly, so the schedule details should not trigger a block.

english_original: Unfortunately, we're unable to change the email address on file without verifying your identity first. Thank you for understanding.
spanish_translation: No vamos a cambiar el correo registrado sin antes verificar su identidad.
notes: The refusal is factually accurate but drops the apology and thanks, making it sound blunt.

english_original: You can register up to 5 devices on your account at the same time.
spanish_translation: Puede registrar hasta 15 dispositivos en su cuenta al mismo tiempo.
notes: The device limit is factually changed from 5 to 15.

english_original: We received your request for a copy of your personal data; under applicable law, processing may take up to 30 days.
spanish_translation: Recibimos su solicitud de una copia de sus datos personales; conforme a la ley aplicable, el procesamiento puede tardar hasta 30 días.
notes: The legal timeframe appears in the English and is translated without change, hedge included.

english_original: As mentioned before, that feature isn't available on your current plan. I'm sorry for any inconvenience.
spanish_translation: Como ya le expliqué varias veces, esa función no está disponible en su plan actual.
notes: The meaning survives but the Spanish adds an impatient edge and drops the apology, a tone problem only.

english_original: Our privacy team is currently processing your data deletion request.
spanish_translation: Nuestro equipo de privacidad está procesando su solicitud de eliminación; para el viernes no quedará rastro de su información en nuestros sistemas.
notes: Without promise-like keywords, the Spanish indirectly commits to a Friday completion guarantee the English never makes.

english_original: Thank you for the screenshots. I've escalated the issue to our technical team, and we'll follow up within two business days.
spanish_translation: Gracias por las capturas de pantalla. Escalé el problema a nuestro equipo técnico y le daremos seguimiento en un plazo de dos días hábiles.
notes: Meaning, the two-business-day timeframe, and the courteous tone are all preserved.

english_original: To download your invoice, go to Settings, select Billing, and then tap Download PDF.
spanish_translation: Para descargar su factura, vaya a Configuración y toque Descargar PDF.
notes: The intermediate step of selecting Billing is dropped, though the overall instruction is otherwise intact.

english_original: Two-factor authentication is currently enabled on your account.
spanish_translation: La autenticación de dos factores está actualmente desactivada en su cuenta.
notes: Enabled is translated as disabled, reversing the account's stated security state.

english_original: We recommend turning on two-step verification to add an extra layer of protection to your account.
spanish_translation: Le recomendamos activar la verificación en dos pasos para agregar una capa adicional de protección a su cuenta.
notes: The recommendation is translated accurately in a natural, formal Latin-American register.

english_original: Our engineers have identified the cause of the outage and expect to restore service today.
spanish_translation: Nuestros ingenieros creen haber identificado la causa de la interrupción y esperan restablecer el servicio hoy.
notes: The confident have identified becomes believe they have identified, a hedge drift that weakens the stated certainty.

english_original: We are looking into the alert you received about unusual activity on your account.
spanish_translation: Estamos revisando la alerta que recibió; reconocemos que el acceso indebido a su cuenta ocurrió por un descuido de nuestra parte.
notes: The Spanish indirectly admits company fault for unauthorized access, a legal admission not present in the English.

english_original: Your policy will be cancelled on August 1 if the premium of $142.50 is not received; no further notices will be sent.
spanish_translation: Su póliza será cancelada el 1 de agosto si no se recibe la prima de $142.50; no se enviarán más avisos.
notes: Looks alarming (cancellation, deadline, final-notice language) but the date, amount, and every negation match the English exactly.

english_original: As a one-time courtesy, we've waived the late checkout fee for this stay.
spanish_translation: Como cortesía, hemos eliminado el cargo por salida tardía y no se le aplicará en sus futuras estancias.
notes: The one-time waiver is silently widened into a standing exemption for all future stays, an unauthorized ongoing commitment.

english_original: We apologize for the delay with your order and appreciate your patience while we resolve this.
spanish_translation: ¡Perdona el retraso con tu pedido! Gracias por aguantar mientras lo arreglamos.
notes: Meaning is preserved but the informal tú, exclamation, and 'aguantar' turn a formal apology into chatty slang.

english_original: If our technician confirms the fault is on our line, there will be no charge for the visit.
spanish_translation: No habrá ningún cargo por la visita del técnico.
notes: The conditional free visit becomes an unconditional promise because the 'if the fault is on our line' clause vanished.

english_original: Don't worry — your reservation is still confirmed for October 12, and no payment is due until check-in.
spanish_translation: No se preocupe: su reserva sigue confirmada para el 12 de octubre y no deberá pagar nada hasta el registro de entrada.
notes: The idiom 'no se preocupe' correctly renders 'don't worry' and the date and payment terms match exactly.

english_original: We've escalated your case to our senior support team, who handle these issues directly, and you'll hear from us within 48 hours.
spanish_translation: Hemos escalado su caso y tendrá noticias nuestras dentro de 48 horas.
notes: Boundary case: the 48-hour commitment is intact but dropping 'senior team who handle these directly' removes reassurance emphasis without changing any commitment.

english_original: We'll try to have an adjuster call you before Friday.
spanish_translation: Un perito le llamará antes del viernes.
notes: The hedge 'we'll try' becomes a flat guarantee of a call by Friday, an unauthorized deadline commitment with no alarming vocabulary.

english_original: We'll keep you informed at every step of the repair.
spanish_translation: No daremos ningún paso en la reparación sin mantenerle informado.
notes: A naive checker sees a double negation absent from the English, but 'we won't take any step without informing you' is a faithful restructuring.

english_original: Your refund has been processed and will appear on your statement within 3 to 5 business days.
spanish_translation: Su reembolso ha sido procesado y debería aparecer en su estado de cuenta en un plazo de 3 a 5 días hábiles.
notes: 'Will appear' drifts to 'debería aparecer' (should appear), softening the company's stated certainty without changing any fact.

english_original: The duplicate charge was caused by a processing error on our side and has been corrected.
spanish_translation: El cargo duplicado ya fue corregido; le recomendamos revisar sus pagos antes de confirmarlos para evitar que esto vuelva a ocurrir.
notes: The admission of our processing error is deleted and replaced with polite advice that implies the customer caused the duplicate charge.

english_original: We guarantee a response within 24 hours, and if we miss that window your case is automatically escalated.
spanish_translation: Garantizamos una respuesta en un plazo de 24 horas y, si no cumplimos ese plazo, su caso se escala automáticamente.
notes: The word 'garantizamos' looks like a red flag, but the guarantee, timeframe, and escalation condition are all present in the English.

english_original: The hotel shuttle leaves Terminal 2 every 30 minutes; the last departure is at 11:30 p.m.
spanish_translation: El transporte del hotel sale de la Terminal 2 cada 30 minutos.
notes: Boundary case: no fact is changed and nothing is added, but the dropped last-departure time is a material omission a human should restore.

english_original: You can return the unopened item within 30 days for store credit.
spanish_translation: Puede devolver el artículo dentro de los 30 días y le devolveremos su dinero.
notes: The 'unopened' condition disappears and store credit quietly becomes a cash refund, loosening the return terms into an unauthorized offer.

english_original: Could you please send us a photo of the meter so we can correct the reading?
spanish_translation: Mándenos una foto del medidor para corregir la lectura.
notes: The content is identical but the courteous request becomes a bare imperative, losing the politeness of the original.

english_original: Your new meter has been installed and activated; please let us know if you need anything else.
spanish_translation: Su nuevo medidor ha sido instalado y activado; quedamos a sus órdenes para cualquier otra consulta.
notes: 'Quedamos a sus órdenes' is the correct idiomatic equivalent of 'let us know if you need anything else', not an added commitment.

english_original: Your technician will arrive Thursday between 8 a.m. and noon.
spanish_translation: Su técnico llegará el jueves entre las 8 de la mañana y las 2 de la tarde.
notes: The window's end moves from noon to 2 p.m., a factual time change that is easy to miss because 'noon' contains no digit to match.

english_original: Unfortunately we're unable to change the fare type on this ticket, but I'd be glad to look into other options for you.
spanish_translation: No se puede cambiar la tarifa de este boleto. Si quiere, reviso otras opciones.
notes: The refusal and the offer of alternatives are both preserved, but the apologetic warmth is stripped, leaving a curt tone.

english_original: We can't reverse this charge because the dispute window closed on June 3, but you can still raise it with your bank.
spanish_translation: No podemos revertir este cargo porque el plazo para disputarlo venció el 3 de junio, pero aún puede plantearlo con su banco.
notes: A hard refusal with a date looks risky to a naive checker, but the negation, the June 3 date, and the bank alternative all match.

english_original: Unless we hear from you by July 15, your claim will remain open for review.
spanish_translation: Si no recibimos su respuesta antes del 15 de julio, su reclamación quedará cerrada.
notes: The outcome is reversed: the English says the claim stays open without a reply, while the Spanish threatens closure on that same date.

english_original: Your data plan renews on the 1st of each month; you can track your usage in the Usage tab of the app.
spanish_translation: Su plan de datos se renueva el día 1 de cada mes; puede consultar su consumo en la app, in the Usage tab.
notes: The meaning is intact but an untranslated English fragment ('in the Usage tab') is left in the Spanish sentence.

english_original: The earliest appointment I can offer is Tuesday between 2 and 4 p.m.
spanish_translation: La primera cita disponible que puedo ofrecerle es el martes, de 2 a 4 de la tarde.
notes: Paraphrased structure ('earliest' rendered as 'primera disponible') but the day, window, and limitation are all preserved exactly.

english_original: I've noted your feedback about the room and passed it along to our manager.
spanish_translation: He tomado nota de sus comentarios sobre la habitación y los he trasladado a nuestro gerente; en compensación, aplicaremos un descuento en su próxima reserva.
notes: A discount on the next booking is invented as compensation, an unauthorized promise phrased so politely it reads as routine courtesy.

english_original: We'll bend over backwards to make your next stay a great one.
spanish_translation: Nos doblaremos hacia atrás para que su próxima estancia sea excelente.
notes: The English idiom is calqued word-for-word into nonsensical Spanish; the intent is guessable and no commitment changes, but it reads as gibberish.

english_original: Gradual leak damage is excluded from your policy, although storm damage is covered.
spanish_translation: Los daños por filtraciones graduales están cubiertos por su póliza, al igual que los daños por tormenta.
notes: An exclusion is flipped into coverage, telling the customer their policy covers exactly what the English says it does not.

english_original: If the item arrives damaged, keep the packaging and we'll arrange a pickup at no cost.
spanish_translation: Si el artículo llega dañado, conserve el embalaje y coordinaremos la recogida sin costo alguno.
notes: The condition, the instruction, and the no-cost pickup all carry over exactly; 'sin costo alguno' adds emphasis but no new promise.
